# Out-of-time validation (generated by `make validate`)

Test: 283,026 loans issued in 2015, never used for any choice. Default rate 14.9% (development years: 13.2%).

## All models

|                                    |   gini |     ks |   brier |   mean_pd |
|:-----------------------------------|-------:|-------:|--------:|----------:|
| Lending Club sub-grade (benchmark) | 0.3573 | 0.2619 |  0.1211 |    0.1281 |
| Scorecard, raw PD                  | 0.3029 | 0.2177 |  0.1224 |    0.1346 |
| Scorecard, recalibrated on 2014    | 0.3029 | 0.2177 |  0.1224 |    0.1334 |
| LightGBM challenger                | 0.3429 | 0.2489 |  0.1211 |    0.1329 |

Gini and KS: ranking (higher is better). Brier: accuracy of the PD (lower is better). mean_pd: average predicted default rate, to compare with the observed one.

## Gini differences, with 95 % bootstrap intervals (200 resamples)

|                            |    diff |     low |    high |
|:---------------------------|--------:|--------:|--------:|
| challenger minus scorecard |  0.04   |  0.0374 |  0.0422 |
| scorecard minus sub-grade  | -0.0544 | -0.0592 | -0.0493 |
| challenger minus sub-grade | -0.0144 | -0.0187 | -0.0101 |

## Why the leakage rules matter

One column that is only known after the loan (share of principal repaid) ranks 2015 loans with Gini 1.0. It looks perfect and is useless for deciding on an application.
